notes.title: Wizards Industry and Tools
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44761993/078059ba4f2305d339dc628de42d9e5c984524d0.png[/img]

The latest Taxing Tiles update brings new ways to shape your world with the Upgrade and Harvest mechanics! Transform tiles, gather resources, and craft powerful tools as you expand your strategy.

New Mechanics:
🔼 Upgrade – Improves certain tiles into stronger versions (Rocks → Gold, Desert → Ruins).
🌾 Harvest – Consumes resources from a tile for valuable rewards.

New Tiles & Buildings:
🏛 Standing Stones – Upgrades surrounding Rocks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44761993/024dd4723c15980c3ff4e77097655f7e3a7bf466.png[/img]
💎 Gem Cutters – Converts Mason Huts into Mines.
🔮 Wizard's Tower – Enhances nearby tiles with magical power.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44761993/b581619809a88b054a84935b8e20349f226fcf5b.png[/img]
⛏️ Mine – Consumes ores and gems for greater rewards.
🔥 Forge – Creates powerful tools—and under the right conditions, the legendary All-Hammer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44761993/24b23af9064dff3d4da5997217b76963bb32c0ac.png[/img]

New Tools:
⚒️ Forge, Sickle, Pickaxe, Axe, Sword, Fishing Rod & All-Hammer – Craft and wield tools to reshape the land!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44761993/2cc2851ea51570798bc31c5c555e69d686b378dc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44761993/768d76921e04324c7aa5e34ee407fbf059ab6c2a.png[/img]


Start upgrading, harvesting, and forging your path to victory in Taxing Tiles! 🚀

notes.title: Ancient Dessert and Deep Oceans
notes.content:
Greetings, adventurers! We're excited to share the latest update for "Taxing Tiles," packed with new relics, ocean treasures, visual upgrades, and strategic improvements that will enrich your journey. Here’s what’s new:

New Tiles: Discover Treasures and Beware Curses
🏛️ Ruins & Pyramids:

Ruins: Uncover ancient secrets hidden beneath the sands! When you play Desert tiles, you may reveal Ruins that generate treasure and relics, adding valuable resources to your deck.
Pyramid & Ruby Pyramid: Venture further into the desert to discover the majestic Pyramids, including the rare Ruby Pyramid. These structures are rich in treasure, but be wary—some treasures come with a price.
🌊 Deep Ocean & Fishing Ship:

Deep Ocean: Explore the vast and mysterious Deep Ocean tiles, a new aquatic landscape teeming with hidden riches.
Fishing Ship: Cast your nets with the Fishing Ship, which can reel in valuable fish like Manta Ray and Trout, providing extra energy for your journey. But remember, to benefit from these catches, you’ll need a card to discard alongside them—or you might just end up with an old boot!
New Relics: Power and Peril
New relics bring powerful effects and new risks:

🏺 Ancient Tablet, Ancient Scarab, & Ancient Idol:

Ancient Tablet & Ancient Scarab: These relics introduce new discard mechanics, allowing you to trigger effects when discarded or gain quick gold when played.
Ancient Idol: This powerful relic can duplicate any card in your hand, offering strategic advantages that could turn the tide of battle.
Evil Idol: Handle with caution! While it may seem valuable, the Evil Idol duplicates itself endlessly. Seek treasure wisely, as you might end up cursed with a hand full of these ominous idols.
New Gameplay Enhancements: Strategy at Your Fingertips
🃏 Hand Size & Board Space: We've updated hand size and board space to give you more room to strategize and plan your moves. Manage your cards carefully as you explore the expanding possibilities of your deck.

✨ Combo Highlights: To help you master your strategy, we’ve added new visual highlights that direct you to potential combos and synergies. These will guide you in making the most of your cards and tiles, unlocking powerful chain reactions.

Fishing for Power:
Manta Ray & Trout: These new fish cards provide extra energy, fueling your strategic plays. But to harness their full potential, you’ll need to pair them with a discard card—balance your deck wisely to take advantage of these oceanic bounties.
New Steam Achievements:
Achievement Hunters Rejoice: We've added a set of new Steam achievements to challenge your skills and reward your mastery of the game’s new mechanics. Can you unlock them all?
Tile Visuals Update:
Enhanced Tile Artwork: We’ve refreshed the visuals of several key tiles, bringing more detail and vibrancy to your game board. Enjoy a richer, more immersive experience as you explore the world of "Taxing Tiles."
This update adds new layers of strategy, visual appeal, and challenges to your adventure in "Taxing Tiles." With the addition of powerful relics, dangerous curses, strategic improvements, and new achievements, your journey through the realm will be more thrilling than ever.

Dive back into "Taxing Tiles" today and explore the treasures and dangers that await! Happy adventuring, and beware of the curses you may uncover!

notes.title: Witches,Kobolds and Tiles
notes.content:
Adventurers, get ready to delve deeper into the realm of "Taxing Tiles" with our latest update, introducing a host of exciting new cards and tiles! Here's a glimpse of what's in store:

New Cards:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44761993/1bd8b7211493eb340ebf9908f0e06cb3a5567f01.png[/img]
👹 Kobold: Beware the sneaky lil burglar! The Kobold prowls the realm, stealing from houses to bolster its own riches. Keep a keen eye out for this mischievous creature.


🏠 Witches House: Unleash mystical powers with the spawn of the Witches House! This enigmatic abode grants you random spell cards to wield in your quest for domination.

💥 Disintegrate: Embrace destruction with Disintegrate! This powerful spell annihilates all cards in your hand, allowing for thinner decks and more streamlined strategies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44761993/260286f842010d54a7b49be8bd7306d713bb2ddb.png[/img]
🏜️ Desert: Prepare for a new twist with the Desert card, introducing fresh discard mechanics to challenge even the most seasoned players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44761993/0df148547527f40b49756e2f5eebc3531ac412f9.png[/img]
🌊 Lake: Experience the tranquil beauty of the Lake, spawning waters to hydrate surrounding tiles and bring life to the barren landscape.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44761993/e776a0e635268beb6adca6475e931877bca73c69.png[/img]
🏙️ Slums: Beware the consequences of urban expansion! With the Slums card, ensure your city doesn't grow too big, lest it become a hub of chaos and despair.

New Tiles:
🏠 Witches House: Dare to summon the most powerful witch with the Witches House tile, which adds random spell cards to your hand, enhancing your arsenal of mystical abilities.

👹 Kobold: Watch out for thieving mischief as the Kobold tile sneaks into your realm, stealing from nearby houses to enrich its own coffers.

🏜️ Desert: Witness the transformative power of the Desert tile, drying up nearby nature tiles and reshaping the landscape with its arid touch.

🌊 Lake: Embrace the rejuvenating force of the Lake tile, hydrating surrounding tiles and fostering new life in the once-barren expanses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44761993/3e68de9a9966607f6a3842c21cc2222966a4ce51.png[/img]
🧙 BabaYaga: Unravel the mystery of the most powerful witch with the BabaYaga tile. Can you summon her and harness her formidable magic?

Prepare to expand your strategies, confront new challenges, and uncover hidden secrets as you journey through the ever-evolving world of "Taxing Tiles"! Update now and embark on your next adventure.

also fixed a but load of bugs and added full screen mode as suggested. let me know what you want to see next.

Happy gaming, adventurers!

Warm regards,
GDO Games
